evals.name: mixed-type-hassabis
evals.prompt: Can you research Demis Hassabis for me? I want a proper dossier — background, career, the DeepMind story, the Nobel, controversies if any.
evals.expected_output: Structured research/<slug>/ folder: 00-summary, 01-index, 02-detailed-research with footnoted citations, 03-timeline, 04-career-history, _working-notes, sources/. Subject-type detection should handle the academic/scientist + tech-founder mixed case. Tier-1 sources should include Nobel committee materials, peer-reviewed pubs, DeepMind/Google filings.
